issues.claim: The American Privacy Rights Act was introduced on April 4, 2026
issues.issue: Congress.gov shows the introduction date as April 7, 2026, not April 4

issues.claim: The bill preempts all existing state privacy laws
issues.issue: Bill text shows partial preemption with carve-outs for California, Illinois, and state consumer protection laws
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify that preemption is partial with specific state carve-outs listed in Section 404

issues.claim: Industry groups have expressed opposition to the enforcement provisions
issues.issue: Source uses 'concern' rather than 'opposition' -- characterization is slightly stronger than source supports
issues.suggested_fix: Change 'opposition' to 'concern' to match source language
